title: Cobra Golf Darkspeed Adapt Women's Hybrid 21 degrees (Right Hand)

comparisons.notes: Women's DS-ADAPT Hybrid, right hand, KBS PGH 55 ladies graphite; right-hand lofts in stock at $179.00 (regular $299 anchor ignored).
New Cobra DS ADAPT women's hybrid, KBS PGH 55 graphite, SKU H9421RGL6 matching the Woot UPC; new-condition price, used listings excluded.

amazon_match_notes: ASIN from the Woot offer data; UPC 887996199877 matches.
writeup: Woot has Cobra's women's Darkspeed Adapt (DS-ADAPT) hybrid, right hand and new, for $89.99. Cobra's own site charges $179 for every right-hand loft and Global Golf has it new at $179.99, so this is about half off. The FutureFit33 hosel offers 33 loft and lie settings, and it comes with a KBS PGH 55 ladies graphite shaft. Only one was left at posting.
